tools.name: search_companies
tools.description: Search the companies tracked by Venture Atlas by free text and/or industry. Matches company name, summary, product names, CEO, headquarters and industry names. Returns slim records with a trimmed brief; call get_company for the full profile. Omit `query` to list every company in an industry.

query.description: Free-text query. Omit to list companies without text filtering.

tools.name: get_company
tools.description: Full Venture Atlas profile for one company: summary, key metrics, forward-looking next steps with target dates, resolved milestone history with hit/slipped/missed outcomes, timeline, funding rounds and total, products, subsidiaries, and its news. Every field carries the source URL it came from.

slug.description: Company slug, for example "spacex" or "form-energy". Use search_companies to find it.

includeOverview.description: Inline the long-form editorial overview when one exists. Large; off by default.

tools.name: list_upcoming_milestones
tools.description: Announced, still-upcoming milestones with target dates across all tracked companies, soonest first. This is the forward-looking view: what each company has committed to next and by when, with the source for the commitment and that company's track record on past announcements. Filter by company or industry.

includeUndated.description: Include milestones whose target has no parseable time signal ("Ongoing"). They sort last.

tools.name: latest_news
tools.description: The Venture Atlas daily news digest, newest first. Each item is a sourced two-to-three-sentence summary of a material development (launch, funding round, regulatory milestone, contract, incident) with the companies it involves. Filter by company or by date.

since.description: Only items dated on or after this ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD).

tools.name: get_robotaxi_tracker
tools.description: Comparable robotaxi operations time series: cumulative distance (km), vehicles, coverage area, and city count, each point sourced. Distance defaults to paid robotaxi km (`distanceKm`); `distanceAllKm` is the broader autonomy series (mixed testing plus Tesla FSD on customer cars). Filter by operator slug or metric name.

metric.description: Optional hint for which series you care about. The full operator record is always returned.

tools.name: get_datacenter_tracker
tools.description: Comparable AI data-center capacity: Epoch AI campus IT power in MW, H100-equivalents for the same campuses, and disclosed raw chip counts on a separate series. Filter by operator slug.

metric.description: Optional hint for which series you care about. The full operator record is always returned.
